# Kids Care Dental

> Multi-location pediatric dentistry and orthodontics practice serving Northern California with specialized care for children.

Kids Care Dental operates 20+ locations across Sacramento, Stockton, San Jose, and surrounding areas in Central California. The practice offers comprehensive pediatric dental services including preventative care, orthodontics, braces, Invisalign, and oral surgery, with online appointment booking through NexHealth and insurance coordination with providers like DentaQuest.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Braces and Invisalign
- Kids dental care
- Sacramento locations
- Stockton locations
- San Jose locations
- Preventative care
- Oral surgery
- Family dentistry

- Multi-location practice

- Children's dental health
